_comment: M-ARC Task A1 -- the act layer. Acts are a COUNTER-DERIVED quest-machinery layer (progress = pure function of counters, the WIQuests idiom), evaluated by WIActs (src/core/acts.gd), NOT stored. The CURRENT act is the highest act whose predecessors' `advance_when` gates are all met (fresh boot = Act I; capped at the last act -- Act III is open-ended until the A3 climax banks `raskghar_sealed`, so its gate stays defined-but-unreachable for now). Conditions share one predicate shape used by both `advance_when` (advance to the next act) and per-beat `when` (journal milestone achieved): `min_classes` (int, classes.size()), `quests_completed` (int, count of COMPLETED started quests via WIQuests), `accomplishments` ({id: min_count}). Empty condition = trivially met. All copy is RESULTS-ONLY and opaque (no stats, canon-warm) per the M-ARC design + repo constraint.
